issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 51,922.46; p2 transfer 'General Fund to MFO Fund 29,824.86, Reason: Transfer MFO fund receipts'
issues.issue: Amount matches the page. The line is 26% of non-transfer receipts with no description, so this fund type is well over the 10% threshold for 'other'. p2 shows MFO (mutual finance organization) receipts arriving in the General Fund; these may sit in this line or in State Receipts: Other. If they are in this line, part of it is intergovernmental/state aid. The page doesn't settle it, so 'other' with review is defensible.
